articles.title: The report complicates Vinicius's presence in the Clásico: "Aggressive attitude" and protests "at the top of his voice"
articles.standfirst: The referee described the Brazilian's "aggressive attitude" when protesting his sending-off for the hair pull, an account that points to a suspension that could rule him out of the clash against Barça
articles.summary: The referee described the Brazilian's "aggressive attitude" when protesting his sending-off for the hair pull, an account that points to a suspension that could rule him out of the clash against Barça
articles.body:
"The referee's report for the match between Real Madrid and Villarreal (1-0), played this Saturday at the Santiago Bernabéu, detailed the sending-off of Vinicius Júnior and the subsequent protests by the Brazilian forward. The match official, Díaz de Mera, recorded in the document both the reason for the red card and an additional incident after the player had already been sent off.

Regarding the card, the report explained that Vinicius was sent off in the 73rd minute “for pulling an opponent’s hair, with the ball in play, without the ball being contested between them” . The incident occurred in the play in which the Brazilian had sent the ball into the net, in a goal that the referee disallowed after spotting that prior infringement.

The referee added a section on “other incidents” in which he described what happened after the sending-off. “In the 73rd minute of the match, with play stopped, the local club’s number 7 player, D. Vinicius José De Oliveira Do Nascimento, after having been sent off and while still on the field of play, continued protesting my decision, shouting at the top of his voice, moving toward the area where I was with an aggressive attitude,” Díaz de Mera wrote.

After having been sent off and while still on the field of play, he continued protesting my decision, shouting at the top of his voice, heading toward the area where I was with an aggressive attitude

The referee also specified that the forward “had to be restrained by teammates” , although he clarified that he could not “make out any specific expression.” The account in the match report, together with the CTA protocol, suggests that the suspension could go beyond a single match and, therefore, Vinicius would miss the Clásico against Barcelona next October 25 . Madrid only plays one league match in between, against Sevilla , so a ban of two or more matches would leave the Brazilian out of the appointment at Camp Nou.

The report was not limited to Vinicius. The referee also showed a caution to José Mourinho and delegate Chendo , and sent off Real Madrid's goalkeeping coach, Nuno Santos , on a night of maximum tension on the white team's bench over the refereeing decisions. For Villarreal, the official sent off Xisco Nadal , Villarreal delegate.

The CTA protocol includes hair-pulling within category CV.1, that of violent conduct, which groups together actions in which a “player delivers an elbow, headbutt, punch, slap, grab by the neck, shove, kick, stomp, bite, hair pull… to an opponent or any other person without contesting the ball, using excessive force or brutality” . This type of action for violent conduct usually carries a suspension of more than one match , a punishment that would leave the Brazilian out of El Clásico against Barcelona, since in between Madrid only plays the league match against Sevilla.

articles.title: Ex-Barcelona president blasts Messi: "Who does he think he is? He should be careful..."
articles.standfirst: The former Barcelona president demands that the Rosario star say goodbye to the blaugrana fans without making his return conditional on Joan Laporta’s presence
articles.summary: The former Barcelona president demands that the Rosario star say goodbye to the blaugrana fans without making his return conditional on Joan Laporta’s presence
articles.body:
'J oan Gaspart has spoken out again about Leo Messi and did so with a forceful message on the podcast "Solo Para Culés." The former Barcelona president spoke about the Argentine's possible farewell at Camp Nou and made it clear that, in his view, the player should return to say goodbye to the fans regardless of who holds the club's presidency.'

Gaspart maintains a special bond with Messi, since he was Barça's president when the Argentine arrived at the club at just 13 years old . Precisely because of that relationship, he wanted to make it clear that his words do not call into question the importance of the number 10 in the club's history.

"I say this from the historical love I have for a player whom I signed when he was 13 years old and I was the president of Barça ," Gaspart explained during the podcast. However, the former executive believes that Messi should not place his personal circumstances above the institution. "He should be careful. Barça is above him," he stated.

"Let him be careful, I say it from the long-standing love I have for a player I signed when he was 13 years old

One of the points he focused on was the relationship between Messi and Joan Laporta . Gaspart believes that the presence of the current president should not be an obstacle for the Argentine to return to Camp Nou and receive the fans' recognition.

' "Whoever the president is, let him come and say goodbye to Barça ," said the former blaugrana president, who was even more forceful when speaking about a possible tribute conditioned on Laporta's departure.'

"If Leo Messi comes to say goodbye and doesn't come because Laporta is the president and comes the day Laporta is no longer there, I would not go to that tribute ," he stated. Gaspart closed his remarks with a phrase that sums up his stance on the role Messi should have with regard to the club: "Who does he think he is?".

articles.title: The Villarreal goalkeeper was the victim of an armed robbery at his home while he and his family were inside
articles.standfirst: The Hungarian goalkeeper is out for the Champions clash against Napoli
articles.summary: The Hungarian goalkeeper is out for the Champions clash against Napoli
articles.body:
Villarreal goalkeeper Peter Gulacsi will be unavailable tonight for the match his team is set to play at La Cerámica against Napoli due to the severe emotional impact suffered after the armed robbery of which he has been the victim in the last few hours.

As the club from La Plana has reported, the footballer suffered an armed robbery during the early hours of this morning while he was at home with his family . The yellow club has reported that, fortunately, no member of his family was injured. The emotional impact has been such that the player is not in condition to play in a match like the one the yellows are playing tonight against Napoli

Peter Gulacsi, who arrived at Villarreal this summer, lives with his wife and his two young children , which gives a good idea of the impact that the scare they went through has had on the family.

This is not the first time that a similar incident has happened to a player from the yellow team. In previous seasons, players such as Toko Ekambi or Zambo Anguissa had already suffered similar situations. Also at Valencia, in previous campaigns, several footballers reported these incidents, such as Garay, Gabriel Paulista or Kondogbia.
